maskRule: Diagonal bits require both adjacent cardinal bits. Masks are normalized before lookup.
artworkChange: 1.16 refines ONLY Terracotta and Moss ground mothers. Existing paving pixels/domain geometry, all old atlas rectangles, roads/decor coordinates and other six themes stay unchanged. New quiet grounds apply only to policy1.16;1.12–1.15 retain original pixels.

groundDiagnostics.note: Actual1024px loop for Snow/Industrial,512px fallback for six other themes. Mathematical periods and recurring donor motifs remain.

atlasSizeMeaning: Authoritative dimensions are themes[].size. Revision1.16 appends one finite768x576 quiet ground field only to03/04, preserving every earlier rectangle and pixel. No new paving designs.

05_snow_path.legacyDerivation: Top-left512px macro clip with exact old outer2px loop collar. Industrial has a24px quantized native-color falloff inside this collar. Not a full-RGBA macro quadrant alias.

07_industrial.legacyDerivation: Top-left512px macro clip with exact old outer2px loop collar. Industrial has a24px quantized native-color falloff inside this collar. Not a full-RGBA macro quadrant alias.

groundSampling.remapCanonicalLegacyGrass: Only fixedLayers.id=grass cells with sourceRect=[512+worldX%512,worldY%512,32,32] and32px-aligned world coordinates use current macro phase. Explicit noncanonical source phases remain untouched.
groundSampling.tileRule: Source XY = region.xy + (worldCell % (region.wh/32))*32. Use complete1024 phases in order, never shuffle individual cells.

pavingAssemblies.eligible: Each4-cell group has all8 neighbors present for every member; existing appearances0/2/4/6 only. No border/hole/narrow-road replacement.
pavingAssemblies.anchorRule: world cell(x,y)=(2*gx+(gy%2),2*gy); quiet whole stones are weighted; adjacent long-pair groups and adjacent large bevel groups are suppressed.

bondPaving.interiorEligibility: All covered cells have all8 neighbors and appearance0/2/4/6. Occupancy-based mixed spans, no fixed64px anchors.
bondPaving.boundaryEligibility: Only two identical face0 straight-edge cells with the same cardinal mask124/199/31/241. Exact old alpha and outer2px collars. Corners, narrow roads and explicit alternate faces stay literal.
bondPaving.backwardsCompatibility: Absent pattern uses unchanged1.9 grouping; disabled or absent macroPaving restores ordinary old tiles.

bridgeCaps.interiorEligibility: Bridge2x3 all full masks and appearances0/2/4/6; deterministic sparse anchors with Manhattan distance at least7. Remaining space uses1.10 packing.
bridgeCaps.boundaryEligibility: Face0 masks exactly match declared two-cell corner or three-cell north/south pattern; complete old alpha and rectangle outer2px exact. Other corners/narrow roads/explicit alternatives stay literal.
bridgeCaps.backwardsCompatibility: mixed_bond_1_10 retains1.10 packing; absent pattern retains1.9; disabled or absent policy retains ordinary tiles.

materialFields.clipping: Per layout.materialField.version. Existing 1.12 layouts retain their original appearance. New 1.13 layouts cover narrow roads, ends, junctions and holes with the same material.
materialFields.limits: Finite768x576. True ends/corners retained.1.14 changes only12px-wide by4px-deep straight junction coverage and3px source-color edge treatment. Large slabs may still be clipped by the chosen path. No infinite seamless or per-stone collision claim.

modes.1.12: Preserved legacy layout policy: only full-neighbor cells use the material field.
modes.1.13: All road cells use the same finite world material. Preserve original silhouette alpha and original four-pixel exposed rim; do not double-draw the old road underneath.
modes.1.14: Continuous world material, repaired artificial straight-run tile junction notches, source-color contact bevel; new finite grass/moss grounds for themes03/04.
modes.1.15: Whole source stone/panel domains selected by anchors and road centreline intersections. Finite contour can exceed logical cells; not collision geometry.

continuousEdges.junctionRepair: Only shared straight boundary: copy adjacent own alpha profiles at-8/+7 over12 columns/rows, depth4px. Real corners/ends untouched.
continuousEdges.edgeTreatment: Based on alpha>=192; inner north/west+14; inner south/east-24; first north/west-12; first south/east-58; third south/east-10. Clamp to8-bit. Same rule in Python and Godot.
continuousEdges.basis: Existing explicit per-pixel editing authorization; no geometric replacement of material design or generated noise.

stoneBoundaries.logicalVsVisual: Road cells remain32px logical inputs; a whole painted stone/panel plus its own grout is selected. Its visible contour may extend beyond those cells. Default eight-theme scenes measured max Chebyshev extension34,48,30,46,36,48,33,38px; arbitrary edited maps may reach source-domain dimensions. Not collision/navigation or constant-width geometry. Finite768x576 canvas can crop stones at outer viewport edge.
stoneBoundaries.selectedRule: Union: anchors in occupied cells, each occupied cell centre domain, and domains intersected by16px centre-to-boundary lines toward occupied cardinal neighbours. Copy selected domain runs at unchanged world positions, deduplicate IDs; no rotation/stretch/grid clipping.

buyerPackage: Current art1.16. Use/Mapping.json is the default takeout index. Original Texture atlas coordinates remain frozen for the editor and legacy layout import.
